text:
`fact_inventory` now has one row per `inventory_id`: 102 rows, 102 distinct ids, matching the 102 distinct ids in the source. The verifier passed the fix.

**Root cause:** The source `inventory_transactions` has exact duplicate rows. Staging has 154 rows for 102 distinct ids. Every duplicated id has identical content in all columns, so no information is lost by keeping one copy. `fact_inventory` passed the rows straight through.

**Change:** In `models/warehouse/fact_inventory.sql` I added a `QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_id ...) = 1` clause. The column list, grain and table materialisation are unchanged. I rebuilt the model with `full_refresh`, and it built successfully.

I did not add a `unique` test on `fact_inventory`, because the schema file has none for this model. I also did not change the staging model, so the duplicates remain in `stg_inventory_transactions`.
